newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Jiangsu Expressway applies for HK listing.
newsitem.headline: China's Jiangsu Expressway applies for HK listing.

text.p: Chinese toll road operator Jiangsu Expressway Co Ltd has applied to the Hong Kong bourse for a H-share listing, a senior official said on Thursday.
Timing of the listing was now up to the exchange, said Xu Huaqiang, director of the Communications Department in Jiangsu province, told reporters at a news conference.
The company, controlled by the Communications Department, owns and operates the Jiangsu section of Shanghai-Nanjing (Huning) Expressway connecting Shanghai and Nanjing.
"Total investment for the 247-km long Jiangsu section is about 6.2 billion yuan," he said.
Xu said the average daily traffic on the Shanghai-Nanjing Expressway was more than 10,000 vehicles.
The company said earlier it planned to raise about HK$4.0 billion yuan by issuing 1.0 billion H-shares in a listing in the first half of 1997.

Proceeds would be used to repay loans, purchase an interest in Jiangsu National Highway number 312 and participate in the development of other highway projects, although details had yet to be finalised, it said.
Xu also said the province planned to invest US$5.0 billion in transport and other infrastructural developments within the 1996-2000 period.

"The money will mainly come from local government investment and central government loans and about a quarter of the total will rely on foreign investments," he said. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
